prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity 16:9 desktop documentation homepage design comp for an open-source Dart terminal UI framework
Input images: Image 1 is the first Noir Data-sublime homepage direction comp and establishes the product, black-and-white identity, lettering character, signal bars, and sine-lattice grammar. Image 2 is the visual-system quality board and sets the finish level. Preserve that complete visual world, but do not copy Image 1's composition.
Primary request: Create a safer, light-dominant variation of the Noir Data-sublime documentation homepage called Luminous Index. It must remain unmistakably the same pure black-and-white data-signal world while giving long-form documentation more daylight, calm, and reading space.
Structure: A white-dominant page with a narrow black navigation band containing NOIR, 0.0.1-alpha.3, Start, Concepts, Guides, Widgets, API, GitHub. The first viewport is one continuous editorial index rather than a standard hero. On the left two-thirds, the exact headline and quick-start command sit in an open white reading field. A dense black cell-bar band descends from the top edge and resolves into the architecture path Widget → Element → RenderObject → Paint. On the right third, a tall black 80×24 terminal output specimen shows a crisp Noir counter. Below the baseline, four wide index rows for Start, Build, Test, Extend alternate black and white and carry small sine traces; no cards.
Content: Exact headline "Reactive terminal UI, measured in cells." Supporting line "Noir brings Flutter-like widgets and retained state to Dart terminal apps." Command "$ dart pub add noir". Architecture line "Widgets declare. Elements preserve identity. RenderObjects layout and record paint." Actions "Get started" and "Read the guides".
Style/medium: Pure black and pure white only; no grey and no color. Pixel-crisp bars, hairline rules, tabular numerics, seeded sine lattice. Use a strong monospace display face only for the headline, signal labels, terminal, and indices; use a restrained proportional sans for explanatory text. White should cover roughly two-thirds of the screen so the direction proves it can support reading.
Composition/framing: 2048×1152 landscape, full browser viewport, strict asymmetric grid, hard fields without rounded containers. Show enough of the second fold to prove documentation rhythm.
Interaction implied: SOURCE / FRAME / TREE is a small black-and-white switch integrated into the index baseline; selection is a full inversion, not a pill. Reduced motion holds the signal as a static field.
Constraints: Professional open-source documentation; clear prerelease status; no invented metrics, testimonials, benchmarks, or company logos; all visible text must be spelled correctly; use no more text than specified.
Avoid: generic SaaS hero, analytics dashboard, grey, color, green terminal cliché, neon, glow, gradients, glass, rounded cards, soft shadows, decorative icons, fake data, QR codes, device mockups, watermarks.
